name: Grade 9 IIT Practice: July Week 7 - Charts and Patterns
description: Practice words for Grade 9 second-trimester Python and data work.

words.definition: A data visual used to compare values and support a conclusion.
words.example: The chart showed how many students chose each lunch option.

words.definition: A chart that compares values using bars.
words.example: The bar chart compared the number of answers in each category.

words.definition: A chart that shows change or trends.
words.example: The line chart showed how temperature changed during the week.

words.definition: A chart that shows points for two values.
words.example: The scatter plot compared screen time and homework time.

words.definition: A relationship or trend noticed in the data.
words.example: The student noticed a pattern where higher practice time led to higher scores.

words.definition: A value that is very different from the others.
words.example: One outlier showed a very high score with very little practice time.

words.definition: A relationship where two things seem to change together.
words.example: The chart suggested a correlation between sleep hours and focus rating.

words.definition: A final idea based on evidence.
words.example: The conclusion explained what the chart pattern probably meant.
